cards.name: Eclipse Observer Nora

coverage_override.reason: Normal- and Special-Summon registrations are event routes for one printed send effect, followed by one opponent-draw trigger; their HOPT clauses are merged.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Eclipse" Quick-Play Spell or 1 "Eclipse Observer" card from your Deck to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Eclipse Observer Nora" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The Normal/Special Summon trigger's Deck filter now accepts Observer cards or an Eclipse Quick-Play Spell from custom set 0xf2f4, Book of Eclipse, or Book of Lunar Eclipse. Both official Eclipse Book IDs are included in AddCodeList/listed_names.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Omega uses a summon-success trigger to select and send one specifically qualified archetype card from the Deck to the GY.
The official Omega DB and script identify Book of Lunar Eclipse as an existing Eclipse-named Quick-Play Spell that the CCG name-based filter must recognize.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the Deck send pool omitted Book of Lunar Eclipse (31834488).

effects.printed_clause: If your opponent draws 2 or more cards at the same time: You can draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Eclipse Observer Nora" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed field EVENT_DRAW trigger requires the opponent to be the drawing player and at least two cards in the draw group, checks the controller can draw one, and performs Duel.Draw(tp,1,REASON_EFFECT) under its own HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Omega reacts to an opponent EVENT_DRAW outside normal ownership, checks the controller can draw, and resolves a follow-up draw with REASON_EFFECT.
Official Omega reads the EVENT_DRAW group size and drawing player, validating the event-group quantity test used for simultaneous multi-card draws.

cards.audit_note: Added Book of Lunar Eclipse consistently to Nora's metadata and Deck send filter.
